keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Frosinone 1, Lecce 0. Matteo Cichella (Frosinone) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Farès Ghedjemis.
Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Frosinone 2, Lecce 0. Giacomo Calò (Frosinone) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
First Half ends, Frosinone 2, Lecce 0.
Substitution, Lecce. Amar Fatah replaces Corrie Ndaba.
Delay in match because of an injury Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Oumar Ngom (Lecce) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Lecce. Nikola Stulic replaces Paco Esteban.
Substitution, Lecce. Olaf Gorter replaces Youssef Maleh.
Substitution, Lecce. Konan N’Dri replaces Omri Gandelman.
Goal! Frosinone 3, Lecce 0. Antonio Raimondo (Frosinone) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Giorgi Kvernadze with a through ball.
Delay in match (Frosinone).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Frosinone. Daniel Bîrligea replaces Antonio Raimondo.
Substitution, Frosinone. Seydou Fini replaces Farès Ghedjemis.

Goal! Frosinone 4, Lecce 0. Daniel Bîrligea (Frosinone) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Romano Schmid following a fast break.Goal awarded following VAR Review.
Substitution, Frosinone. Anouar El Azzouzi replaces Giacomo Calò.
Substitution, Frosinone. Luis Hasa replaces Romano Schmid.
Jamil Siebert (Lecce) is shown the yellow card for handball.
Substitution, Frosinone. Omar Fayed replaces Gabriele Calvani.
Goal! Frosinone 4, Lecce 1. Joël Monteiro (Lecce) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Olaf Gorter following a fast break.
Substitution, Lecce. Mohamed Kaba replaces Joël Monteiro.
Delay in match because of an injury Aleksa Terzic (Frosinone).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Frosinone 5, Lecce 1. Daniel Bîrligea (Frosinone) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Giorgi Kvernadze following a corner.
